firstTaskPrompt.en: Use $web-app-security on this repository. Start with source and local checks only. Record scope and assumptions. Classify every result as confirmed, suspected, unknown, or not_applicable. Prepare the smallest reviewable hardening patch, do not apply risky or production changes without approval, retest every applied fix, and finish with fixed, remaining, and unreached risks.
firstTaskPrompt.zh-CN: 在这个仓库使用 $web-app-security。先只执行源码与本地检查，记录范围和假设；把每项结果标为 confirmed、suspected、unknown 或 not_applicable；准备最小且可审查的加固补丁，未经批准不应用高风险或生产变更；复测每项已应用修复，最后列出已修复、仍存在和未覆盖的风险。

limits: Application controls are not attributed to every route.
A missing route-scoped control or visible query constraint is review evidence, not vulnerability proof.
Access-chain analysis stops before a second project-local call.
Supabase always requires external RLS-policy evidence.
The fixed-commit ordinary-project review produced 12 partial and zero completed chains.
